# Intra-operator Analysis

```{python}
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

REQUIRED_RAW_COLUMNS = ("Group", "L*", "b*")
BODY_SITE_NORMALIZATION = {
    "Palmer": "Palmar",
    "Arm": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Arms": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Inner arm": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Inner upper arm": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Inner upperarm": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Back of hand": "Back of Hand",
    "Fingernail (A)": "Fingernail",
    "Dorsal (B)": "Dorsal",
    "Dorsal - DIP (B)": "Dorsal",
    "Palmar (C)": "Palmar",
    "Inner Arn (D)": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Inner Upper Arm (D)": "Inner Upper Arm",
    "Forehead (E)": "Forehead",
    "Forehead (G)": "Forehead",
}
BODY_SITE_ORDER = ["Inner Upper Arm", "Dorsal", "Forehead", "Palmar"]
SUBJECT_REPEATABILITY_PATTERN = re.compile(r"Subject\s*(\d+)_([A-Za-z]+)_(\d+)$", re.IGNORECASE)
TEST_WITH_REPEATABILITY_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"test with\s+(.+?)(?:-\d+)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d+)$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def compute_ita(l_value: float, b_value: float) -> float:
    if pd.isna(l_value) or pd.isna(b_value) or b_value == 0:
        return np.nan
    return float(np.degrees(np.arctan((l_value - 50.0) / b_value)))


def select_median_ita_rows(df: pd.DataFrame, group_columns: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scored = df.copy()
    scored["_median_ita"] = scored.groupby(group_columns)["ita"].transform("median")
    scored["_distance"] = (scored["ita"] - scored["_median_ita"]).abs()
    scored = scored.sort_values(group_columns + ["_distance", "ita"], kind="mergesort")
    reduced = (
        scored.groupby(group_columns, as_index=False)
        .head(1)
        .drop(columns=["_median_ita", "_distance"])
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    reduced["measurement"] = reduced["ita"]
    return reduced


def extract_repeatability_metadata(path: Path) -> tuple[str, str, int]:
    subject_match = SUBJECT_REPEATABILITY_PATTERN.search(path.stem)
    if subject_match:
        subject = f"Subject{int(subject_match.group(1))}"
        operator = subject_match.group(2).upper()
        repeat_version = int(subject_match.group(3))
        return subject, operator, repeat_version

    test_match = TEST_WITH_REPEATABILITY_PATTERN.search(path.stem)
    if test_match:
        subject = test_match.group(1).strip().title()
        operator = test_match.group(2).upper()
        repeat_version = int(test_match.group(3))
        return subject, operator, repeat_version

    raise ValueError(
        "Could not extract repeatability metadata from filename. "
        f"Expected either 'Subject3_EB_1.csv' or '... test with Katie-2 KH 1.csv': {path.name}"
    )


def collect_repeatability_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    files = sorted(
        file
        for file in root.rglob("*")
        if file.is_file() and file.suffix.lower() in {".csv", ".xlsx", ".xls"}
    )
    matched = []
    for file in files:
        try:
            extract_repeatability_metadata(file)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        matched.append(file)
    if not matched:
        raise ValueError(
            "No repeatability files were found. Expected filenames like "
            "'Subject3_EB_1.csv' or '8-31-2026 test with Katie-2 KH 1.csv'."
        )
    return matched


def load_repeatability_data(files: list[Path]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []

    for file in files:
        subject, operator, repeat_version = extract_repeatability_metadata(file)

        if file.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
            df = pd.read_csv(file)
        else:
            df = pd.read_excel(file)

        missing = [column for column in REQUIRED_RAW_COLUMNS if column not in df.columns]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"{file.name} is missing required columns: {', '.join(missing)}")

        trip = df.copy()
        trip["source_file"] = file.name
        trip["subject"] = subject
        trip["operator"] = operator
        trip["repeat_version"] = repeat_version
        trip["body_site"] = trip["Group"].astype(str).str.strip().replace(BODY_SITE_NORMALIZATION)
        trip["L*"] = pd.to_numeric(trip["L*"], errors="coerce")
        trip["b*"] = pd.to_numeric(trip["b*"], errors="coerce")
        trip = trip.dropna(subset=["body_site", "L*", "b*"])
        trip = trip[trip["body_site"].isin(BODY_SITE_ORDER)].copy()
        trip["ita"] = trip.apply(lambda row: compute_ita(row["L*"], row["b*"]), axis=1)
        frames.append(trip)

    if not frames:
        raise ValueError("No valid repeatability records were loaded from the matched files.")

    combined = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    reduced = select_median_ita_rows(combined, ["body_site", "subject", "operator", "repeat_version"])
    reduced["body_site"] = pd.Categorical(reduced["body_site"], categories=BODY_SITE_ORDER, ordered=True)
    reduced["_subject_sort_num"] = pd.to_numeric(reduced["subject"].str.extract(r"(\d+)")[0], errors="coerce")
    reduced["_subject_sort_text"] = reduced["subject"].astype(str)
    reduced = reduced.sort_values(
        ["_subject_sort_num", "_subject_sort_text", "body_site", "operator", "repeat_version"],
        na_position="last",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    return reduced.drop(columns=["_subject_sort_num", "_subject_sort_text"])


def summarize_intra_operator(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    cell_df = (
        df.groupby(["subject", "body_site", "operator"], observed=True)
        .agg(
            n_repeats=("measurement", "size"),
            mean_median_ita=("measurement", "mean"),
            cell_sd=("measurement", "std"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["subject", "body_site", "operator"])
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    summary_rows: list[dict[str, float | int | str]] = []
    for operator, operator_df in cell_df.groupby("operator", observed=True):
        valid = operator_df["cell_sd"].dropna()
        pooled_within_sd = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(valid)))) if not valid.empty else np.nan
        repeatability = 1.96 * np.sqrt(2) * pooled_within_sd if pd.notna(pooled_within_sd) else np.nan
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "operator": operator,
                "n_cells": int(operator_df["cell_sd"].notna().sum()),
                "pooled_within_sd": pooled_within_sd,
                "repeatability_coefficient": repeatability,
            }
        )

    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows).sort_values("operator").reset_index(drop=True)
    return cell_df, summary_df


def build_flagged_cells(df: pd.DataFrame, cell_df: pd.DataFrame, threshold: float = 5.0) -> pd.DataFrame:
    wide = (
        df.pivot_table(
            index=["subject", "body_site", "operator"],
            columns="repeat_version",
            values="measurement",
            aggfunc="first",
            observed=True,
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    version_numbers = sorted(column for column in wide.columns if isinstance(column, (int, np.integer)))
    wide = wide.rename(columns={column: f"median_ita_v{int(column)}" for column in version_numbers})
    flagged = cell_df[cell_df["cell_sd"] > threshold].copy()
    if flagged.empty:
        return flagged

    merged = flagged.merge(wide, on=["subject", "body_site", "operator"], how="left")
    desired_columns = ["subject", "body_site", "operator", "n_repeats", "cell_sd"] + [
        f"median_ita_v{version}" for version in version_numbers
    ]
    return merged[desired_columns].sort_values(["subject", "body_site", "operator"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def validate_repeatability_layout(df: pd.DataFrame, cell_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    operators = sorted(df["operator"].unique())
    if len(operators) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least two operators are required for this report.")

    insufficient = cell_df[cell_df["n_repeats"] < 3][["subject", "body_site", "operator", "n_repeats"]]
    if not insufficient.empty:
        preview = insufficient.head(10).to_dict("records")
        raise ValueError(
            "Each Subject x Body site x Operator cell must have at least 3 repeated files. "
            f"Examples of insufficient cells: {preview}"
        )


def render_heatmap(cell_df: pd.DataFrame, output_path: Path) -> None:
    heatmap_df = cell_df.copy()
    heatmap_df["body_site"] = pd.Categorical(
        heatmap_df["body_site"], categories=BODY_SITE_ORDER, ordered=True
    )
    def subject_sort_key(value: str) -> tuple[int, str | int]:
        match = re.search(r"\d+", value)
        if match:
            return (0, int(match.group(0)))
        return (1, value)

    subject_order = sorted(heatmap_df["subject"].unique(), key=subject_sort_key)
    operator_order = sorted(heatmap_df["operator"].unique())
    heatmap_df["subject"] = pd.Categorical(heatmap_df["subject"], categories=subject_order, ordered=True)
    heatmap_df = heatmap_df.sort_values(["subject", "body_site", "operator"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    heatmap_df["subject_group"] = heatmap_df["subject"].astype(str) + " | " + heatmap_df["body_site"].astype(str)

    matrix = heatmap_df.pivot(index="subject_group", columns="operator", values="cell_sd").reindex(
        columns=operator_order
    )
    annot = matrix.apply(lambda column: column.map(lambda value: "" if pd.isna(value) else f"{value:.2f}"))

    fig_height = max(4.5, len(matrix) * 0.45)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, fig_height))
    sns.heatmap(
        matrix,
        annot=annot,
        fmt="",
        cmap="YlOrRd",
        linewidths=0.5,
        linecolor="white",
        cbar_kws={"label": "SD of median ITA"},
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_xlabel("Operator", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Subject | Body site", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=0)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", rotation=0)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
```

```{python}
input_path = Path("data/8-31-2026 triplicates")
output_dir = Path("results/repeatability_validation_2026_08_31_triplicates")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

files = collect_repeatability_files(input_path)
repeatability_df = load_repeatability_data(files)
cell_df, summary_df = summarize_intra_operator(repeatability_df)
validate_repeatability_layout(repeatability_df, cell_df)
flagged_df = build_flagged_cells(repeatability_df, cell_df, threshold=5.0)

heatmap_path = output_dir / "repeatability_intra_operator_heatmap.png"
render_heatmap(cell_df, heatmap_path)

repeatability_df.to_csv(output_dir / "repeatability_preprocessed_measurements.csv", index=False)
cell_df.to_csv(output_dir / "repeatability_cell_level_sd.csv", index=False)
summary_df.to_csv(output_dir / "repeatability_operator_summary.csv", index=False)
flagged_df.to_csv(output_dir / "repeatability_flagged_cells_sd_gt_5.csv", index=False)
```
